name: deps.dev
tagline: Google Open Source Insights API for package versions, advisories, and dependency graphs.
description: Public API from Google Open Source Insights (deps.dev) providing package metadata, versions, security advisories, and dependency graphs across multiple ecosystems (npm, PyPI, Maven, Go, Cargo, NuGet, and more). Free to use for querying package information and vulnerability data without authentication for basic access.

auth.details: No authentication required for public API access.

use_cases: look up package versions and metadata across ecosystems
check security advisories for a package
fetch dependency graphs for a package version
compare package health and maintenance signals
resolve transitive dependencies for supply-chain analysis
